payload.text: hv, 10 Nov, first-hand in vc's session: "I want that done tonight." UTILZ 2.14.10 IS RELEASED, carrying ST0034 (issue 0138: arngz records the size an app enforces and rechecks it, so diff and apply agree; arngz 1.2.1). Landed at 20abb0dd, with its version note at 0342aee6 and arm 63's harness fix at 104efca0. Each was checked by vc by change. The proof: ST0034's driver ALL PASS (09d003e3); R-full at 0342aee6 with 17 of 18 rc 0, arngz's one red being arm 63, a race between the fake hs and a 1s deadline that predates ST0034; and arngz's suite at 104efca0, 165 of 165 (1635b4fc). The cut, release commit 4553a289, took three runs. (1) From vc's shell it stopped at macos: vc's shell cannot read hv's keychain. (2) hv's resume read the cancelled CI run that run 1 left behind: Devbin's ci-state takes the worst run at the commit, a defect devbin-vc confirmed from source and is filing. (3) hv deleted that run and resumed again from hv's own terminal, and the cut completed at 19:02:48Z. vc verified it at 19:03Z from the remotes: tag 2.14.10 (d83b1f5f) peels to 4553a289; the release has a notarised Menuz.app.zip and SHA256SUMS; candidate CI run 42877918756 succeeded on all eight jobs; the tap is at 2.14.10. Freeze lifted. A cut's macOS leg must run in hv's own terminal, not through a Claude's shell. Still open: ST0034/WP01 and issue 0138, on AC-01.6, hv's live zeophq run. Peers read this decision at pickup; dc records no copy.
